Account identity and provider mapping

ConcernOwner / rule
Authoritative OwnerBackend GameService for durable record; zone validates gameplay-originating changes while holding the current character/zone lease
Runtime CacheURPGAccountSession
Replication OwnerAuthenticated backend response to intended recipient; no generic public PlayerState replication of this record
Persistence StorePostgreSQL public.accounts
Stable IdentityAccountId UUID; unique (provider,subject)
Source Of Changesauthenticated provider exchange
Validation PathAuthenticated command -> identity/ownership/current epoch -> definition and expected revision -> DB row locks/constraints -> single transaction + receipt
Revisionbigint revision incremented by successful mutation; command replay returns existing revision; sessions additionally require Epoch
Failure PolicyOn uncertain result query the same CommandId; do not invent a fresh reward. Cache refreshes from committed receipt/snapshot. Stale epoch rejected. Reconnect/transfer rebuilds projection without replaying grants.
Ui ObserverWBP_Login
First Phase4
Model AssetDB_accounts
Owner AssetURPGAccountSession
